reason: The registered test is a coherent, deliberately restrictive consequence test for exact raw ol whole forms: same-paragraph written bare-core direction, definite-boundary handling, own-edition paragraph capacity, both primary forms, and the stated lexical rival are kept explicit. It can reject a form/direction contract or retain conditional compatibility; it has no independent meaning capacity and cannot establish a referent, shedy/shey content value, anaphora generally, or an English word. No silent rescue, reserve access, source borrowing, or semantic reopening is registered. GDT933's conditional participant drafts remain conditional and IDEA000022/IDEA000279 blockers remain intact.

blockers.detail: Exact same-paragraph core occurrence tests only a written-reference compatibility condition. It does not independently bind an individual referent or the meaning of shedy, shey, ol, or the whole form; a compatible count cannot select the lexical rival or confirm a word.

not_sufficient: A compatible direction, exact-core rate, or family-diagnostic pattern does not confirm a word, content meaning, or individual referent.
Do not relabel TARGET_BOUNDARY_UNCERTAIN, NO_PARAGRAPH_CAPACITY, or UNRESOLVED_SOURCE as support; report them separately from MISSING_WRITTEN_ANCHOR contradictions.
Do not use GDT933 participant prose, olkain/olkeedy/olchey diagnostics, or alternate-reader agreement as independent semantic controls or rescue evidence.
Do not reopen IDEA000022 or IDEA000279 without their registered independent design requirements.

relations.detail: Retains its conditional paragraph participant drafts and explicit no-meaning-selection conclusion.
The exact written-core contract does not supply the independently coded compatible antecedent and controls required by the blocked proposal.
Reference-direction compatibility does not meet the blocked shell-change/kernel-content design requirement.
